structure: California History-Social Science Framework (2016), narrative framework, not a standards table. Chapters are grade/course chapters: Ch.15 Grade Ten (continues from earlier part; this range holds its last pages), Ch.16 Grade Eleven (US history, late 19th c. to present), Ch.17 Grade Twelve Principles of American Democracy (one semester), Ch.18 Grade Twelve Principles of Economics (one semester), Ch.19 Assessment (backup). Each page repeats a one-line grade header (e.g. 'Grade Eleven') as a text unit, labeled backup; running headers show 'Chapter N | California History-Social Science Framework'. Chapters open with a title and a stack of guiding questions (bullets rendered as 'n'/'nn'), then course overview narrative, then unit headings (e.g. 'The 1920s', 'Fundamental Principles of American Democracy') each with guiding questions and narrative. 'Grade X Classroom Example: ...' vignette boxes continue across pages with 'Example (continued)' and end with a 'CA HSS Content Standard: ... CA HSS Analysis Skills ... CCSS ... ELD' alignment line; these are labeled examples. Formal standards (codes like 11.2.1, PAD 12.4) are only cited, not reproduced, in this range; they are in Appendix C (outside range). Ch.19 contains figures 19.1-19.5 extracted as table cells (T1 Rn Cn).
